material_systems.name: PVA Drywall Primer
material_systems.description: Polyvinyl acetate (PVA) primer for bare drywall ceilings. Economical, fast-drying, excellent sealing of porous drywall surfaces. Standard choice for new construction.

products.notes: PVA-based primers seal porous drywall and provide good holdout for topcoats. Zero stain blocking — sealer only (RC-002). Low VOC, water cleanup.

material_systems.name: Acrylic Latex Primer
material_systems.description: Premium acrylic latex primer for new drywall ceilings. Superior adhesion, better hide, excellent topcoat holdout. Recommended for QT4 work.

products.notes: Acrylic latex provides better adhesion and build than PVA, and better topcoat compatibility. Zero stain blocking — sealer only (RC-002).

material_systems.name: High-Build Drywall Primer
material_systems.description: High-build primer for Level 5 finish or when maximum ceiling surface uniformity is required. Fills minor imperfections. Heavier product increases overhead fatigue.

example_products: Benjamin Moore Ultra Spec 500 Interior High Build Primer
products.notes: High-build formula fills minor imperfections and provides uniform porosity across joints and field. May require light sand before topcoat. Heavier product increases fatigue on overhead application.

coverage_profiles.assumptions: Bare drywall ceiling, proper application thickness, standard porosity. Same absorption as walls.
Level 3 has more exposed paper, higher absorption, lower coverage
Texture increases surface area, reduces coverage 15-25%
High-build applied at greater thickness, lower coverage by design
